capabilities: Export a note, book note, or folder as EPUB3
Assemble a book from a note's embedded chapters
Reorder chapters in a sidebar that writes the order back into the book note
Import a folder as a book note or consolidate a book note into numbered chapter files
Generate a book cover via the Local Image Generator plugin
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Full documentation and a troubleshooting guide live on an external docs site; the README is bilingual (English/German) and supports German metadata field names.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export notes or a folder of chapters as a standalone EPUB e-book.

relations.evidence: Generate a cover from the book note when the Local Image Generator plugin is installed.

summary: EPUB3 exporter that turns a single note, a book note with embedded chapters, or a whole folder into an EPUB e-book.
